title: 第一卷 第6117章 规则天网第一卷 第6116章 可怕青年第三尊序列之王
content_zh:
哧！
极致无匹无敌的一刀，硬生生斩破了眼前青年所有的防御。
而后，破开了其魂海，斩杀到了神魂之上。
然而，就在这一刹，叶寒仿佛在冥冥中听到了一道刺耳的撞击音波。
天意如刀的刀体，如同斩杀在了无坚不摧的物质之上。
在这恍惚中，叶寒仿佛看到了青年的魂海内部深处。
在那魂海之中，似乎悬浮着一张神圣无上的神图。
那神图，护住了青年的神魂，让自己的这一刀根本造成不了任何影响。
“这是什么至宝？”
叶寒极其意外，受到了强烈的心灵冲击。
这尊第八层诸天所属的可怕青年，简直……
简直和自己一样，随身携带着各种各样的顶级宝物。
叶寒几乎可以断定，这一切，并非来源于他背后的势力，而是这青年本身就拥有的际遇。
这家伙，虽然诞生于第八层诸天，可绝对不是那种温室里养出的苗子。
是真正经过了生死历练的生灵。
甚至……
有可能拥有类似自己的成长轨迹。
这样的对手，极其难缠。
“好手段！”
就在这一刻，眼前的青年冷笑起来。

虽然魂海被展开，然而没有任何的怒火涌现。
反而，隐约之间让叶寒有一种熟悉的情绪涌现。
这青年……
似乎反而兴奋了起来？
在最初踏入这葬神之地不久的时候，叶寒也是这样的兴奋。
兴奋的原因，就是能在葬神之地猎杀到第八层诸天的顶级天骄，从而得到前所未有的好处。
显然，这青年也将自己当成了猎物。
“规则天网！”
青年吐出四个字。
一种无上大术突然发动了。
其掌指一挥，足足三百六十种强大的规则一下子爆发。
三百六十道闪烁变幻的星空光痕出现，彼此纵横交错，顷刻就编制出了一张封锁星河的无上大网。
这大网降临下来，再一次锁定了叶寒的本体。
“空有肉身力量的蝼蚁！”
content_en:
Chi!
The ultimate invincible sword cut through all the defenses of the young man in front of him.
Then, he broke through his soul sea and killed him above the soul.
However, at this moment, Ye Han seemed to hear a harsh impact sound wave in the dark.
The blade of God's Will is like a sword, as if it is beheading on an indestructible material.
In this trance, Ye Han seemed to see the depths of the young man's soul sea.
In that sea of ​​souls, there seems to be a sacred and supreme divine map suspended.
The divine map protected the young man's soul, preventing his sword from having any impact at all.
"What kind of treasure is this?"
Ye Han was extremely surprised and received a strong spiritual shock.
This terrifying young man who belongs to the eighth layer of heavens is simply...
Just like himself, he carries all kinds of top-notch treasures with him.
Ye Han could almost conclude that all this did not come from the power behind him, but from the fate of the young man himself.
Although this guy was born on the eighth level of the heavens, he was definitely not the kind of seedling raised in a greenhouse.
They are creatures that have truly experienced life and death.
Even...
It is possible to have a growth trajectory similar to your own.
Such an opponent is extremely difficult to deal with.
"What a trick!"
At this moment, the young man in front of him sneered.
Although the soul sea was unfolded, no anger emerged.
Instead, Ye Han vaguely felt a familiar emotion emerge.
This young man...
You seem to be getting excited instead?
Ye Han was also so excited not long after he first entered this place where gods were buried.
The reason for the excitement is that he can hunt down the top geniuses of the eighth level of heaven in the God Burial Land, thereby getting unprecedented benefits.
Obviously, this young man also regarded himself as prey.
"Rule Skynet!"
The young man spit out four words.
A supreme art suddenly started.
With a wave of his palm, a total of three hundred and sixty powerful rules burst out.
Three hundred and sixty flickering light traces appeared in the starry sky, criss-crossing each other, and instantly formed a huge network that blocked the galaxy.
This big net came down and once again locked onto Ye Han's body.
"Ant with no physical strength!"
